senses.definition: A type of radiation that can pass through some materials, or a picture made with it.
senses.example: The doctor showed us an X-ray where the bones appeared pale.

senses.definition: To make a picture of the inside of something using this type of radiation.
senses.example: The dentist X-rayed my teeth to check below the surface.

senses.definition: Plant tissue that carries water and minerals from the roots toward the leaves.
senses.example: The tree’s xylem carried water into branches above the roof.

senses.definition: A musical instrument with wooden bars of different lengths that make different notes when struck.
senses.example: I played three notes on the xylophone.
